UI_JTIF_Enabled_TT:
Master switch.
Hides surrounding jumbo trees while indoors, and road-covering XL/XXL trees while driving.
Turn off to compare with vanilla rendering on the spot.
UI_JTIF_Drive_TT:
While driving, canopies covering the road ahead are hidden.
Trunks stay visible, so collision obstacles remain in view.
UI_JTIF_LookAhead_TT:
How far ahead road-covering trees are hidden.
Scales with speed.
UI_JTIF_Walk: Hide canopies around you while on foot
UI_JTIF_Walk_TT:
While moving on foot outdoors, hides XL/XXL canopies all around you, in every direction.
Trunks stay visible, so trees remain selectable for chopping.
Canopies return when you stand still.
UI_JTIF_WalkRange_TT:
How far around you canopies are hidden while on foot.
Standard covers the full reach of a canopy.
Narrow and Minimal keep it closer to you.
UI_JTIF_WalkIncludeL: Include smaller jumbo trees while on foot
UI_JTIF_WalkIncludeL_TT:
Also fades L-size jumbo trees around you while on foot, not just XL and XXL.
Leaving it off keeps the forest scenery denser.
Requires the Fade style, since L-size trees have no separate trunk sprite.
UI_JTIF_HideStyle_TT:
How canopies are hidden while driving and on foot.
Fade keeps the canopy as a ghost that thins toward the top.
Trunk only removes the canopy entirely, leaving just the trunk.
